authority: Wayne INTERNAL, domain-wide — the four-category coaching rubric for the Wayne-SMB OS Platform (any shop, any location). Not the client's wording; the client's KPI logic lives in client-rubric-example.json and both ride every grade.
scale: 1-5 per category; total 4-20 computed in code

categories.greeting_score: stated the shop name, polite and branded introduction
categories.discovery_score: asked clarifying questions, understood the customer's actual issue
categories.action_score: attempted to book an appointment or recommend a relevant service

observations.hostility_flag: true if the customer became hostile, threatened a negative review, or demanded a manager
observations.coaching_note: one specific, actionable instruction naming what the rep should have said or done

policy_lives_in: sys-firewall/rc-qa-gate/src/policy.js — the model never decides an alert
scope: Wayne-SMB OS Platform · domain-wide · pairs with a client rubric per launch
